title: 1010Benja shows Suno can be more than an AI music slop engine (The Verge)
notes: The Verge (top-tier), Terrence O'Brien, 2026-07-19. 1010Benja uses Suno on EP 'Time Has Nothing To Do With What You Choose…' (2026), opener 'Semiramis' Dream'; human vocals/lyrics + beat (Patrick Holder) fed through Suno/Ableton loop ~hundreds of times; Deezer flags AI-generated; Benja not hiding credit; follow-up to 2024 'Ten Total'.
